def main():

    pos = 0

    T = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    adj = [set() for _ in range(S + 1)]
    for _ in range(T):
        x = int(data[pos]); y = int(data[pos + 1]); pos += 2
        adj[x].add(y)
        adj[y].add(x)
    P = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    valid = 0
    for _ in range(P):
        N = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
        seq = data[pos:pos + N]
        pos += N
        ok = True
        cur = int(seq[0])
        for i in range(1, N):
            nxt = int(seq[i])
            if nxt not in adj[cur]:
                ok = False
                break
            cur = nxt
        if ok:
            valid += 1
    print(valid)
